# Masterji's Order

<!-- STEP id="routes" -->
A made-up example. Masterji's workshop gets an order for 40 school uniforms. He can stitch them in two ways, and both take the same number of days. He can employ 4 tailors at ₹250 a day each, which costs ₹1,000 a day. Or he can rent a power sewing line, with its operator, for ₹1,200 a day.

**Today the tailors cost less, so Masterji chooses more workers.**
